zusbml: Read, Write and Derive Equations from 'SBML' Models

Source: R/zusbml-package.R
zusbml-package.Rd

Reads Systems Biology Markup Language ('SBML') core documents, Level 3 Versions 1 and 2 and Level 2 Versions 4 and 5, into one R object, writes that object back as Level 3 Version 2, and derives from it the states, right-hand sides, assignments and events an ordinary differential equation solver needs, following the specification at https://sbml.org/documents/specifications/.

Scope

zusbml reads SBML Level 3 Versions 1 and 2 core, and Level 2 Versions 4 and 5 mapped to the Level 3 meaning, and writes Level 3 Version 2. Derivation covers reactions, assignment and rate rules, initial assignments, function definitions, rateOf, conversion factors, compartments that change size, and events with delays, priorities and persistence.

It refuses, with a zusbml_unsupported error naming the construct:

  • SBML Level 3 packages (comp, fbc, layout, qual, ...), unless sbml_read(ignore_packages = TRUE);

  • Level 1 and Level 2 Versions 1 to 3;

  • in derivation, algebraic rules (a DAE), the delay csymbol (a delay differential equation) and fast reactions;

  • in sbml_to_rxode2(), events, unless dropped on request.

It does not check units, validate against libSBML's full rule set, or simulate on its own: sbml_derivs() hands the equations to deSolve.
